It is rewritten by name in the transition inversions release_ok, evolve_ok, withdraw_ok and both foldOne characterisations (Lemmas.lean simp-only lists), which in turn mirror the public *_iff contracts. Helper status follows from that statement-level unfolding plus those named textual uses, never from its filename.
